props.gloss_en: [Rav Dimi's position, as Abaye formulates it:] nullified impurity is as though it were present
the mishna: valid [heifer] ashes mixed with hearth ashes -- follow the majority to impart impurity; if the majority is hearth ashes, it does not impart impurity
R' Yosei b'R' Chanina [on the ashes mishna]: [the hearth-ash majority mixture] is pure from imparting impurity by contact
R' Yosei b'R' Chanina: but it imparts impurity by carrying
Rav Chisda: a carcass is nullified in slaughtered meat, since a carcass cannot become slaughtered meat
R' Chiyya teaches: carcass and slaughtered meat nullify each other
R' Yosei b'R' Chanina on it: [the mixture] is pure from imparting impurity by contact
R' Yosei b'R' Chanina: but it imparts impurity by carrying
R' Eliezer b. Yaakov: a large animal that expelled a mass of blood -- it is buried, and [the animal] is exempt from the firstborn obligation
R' Chiyya teaches: [the mass] does not impart impurity by contact
R' Chiyya teaches: nor by carrying
bar Padda: severe impurity [persists through decay] until [it is unfit for] a ger
and light impurity until [it is unfit for] a dog
R' Yochanan: both this and that -- [severe impurity too] until [it is unfit for] a dog
bar Padda's reason: 'you shall not eat any carcass; to the ger [within your gates you may give it]' (Devarim 14:21)
what is fit for a ger is called a carcass
and what is not fit for a ger is not called a carcass
[R' Yochanan reads the verse] to exclude a carcass that was decayed from the outset
[bar Padda:] one decayed from the outset needs no verse to exclude it -- it is mere dust
R' Yochanan: it is because of nullification in the majority that they touched upon it [and declared it not impure]
R' Eliezer b. Yaakov: pure brine into which any amount of water fell is impure
Rabba bar Avuha: this is to say that the amei haaretz are suspected of mixing half [water] into brine
the impurity of an am haaretz is rabbinic and the impurity of liquids is rabbinic; the Sages decreed for a majority, and for half-and-half they did not decree

objections.gloss_en: איתיביה: majority hearth ashes -- no impurity; if impurity is as though present, granted not by contact, let it impart by carrying!

answered_by.gloss_en: הא איתמר עלה: R' Yosei b'R' Chanina -- pure by contact, but it does impart by carrying (p_rybch_efer_masa_tamei)

objections.gloss_en: והאמר רב חסדא: a carcass is nullified in slaughtered meat -- granted not by contact, let it impart by carrying! (kind svara under protest: an amoraic-memra contradiction)

answered_by.gloss_en: אתון בדרב חסדא מתניתו לה, אנן בדרבי חייא מתנינן לה: R' Chiyya -- they nullify each other, and R' Yosei b'R' Chanina on it -- impure by carrying (p_rybch_nevela_masa_tamei)

objections.gloss_en: והא דתנן (R' Eliezer b. Yaakov's mass of blood) and R' Chiyya: not by contact nor by carrying -- why? let it impart by carrying! אישתיק (Rav Dimi was silent)

answered_by.gloss_en: דלמא ודאי שאני הכא, דהויא לה טומאה סרוחה -- perhaps it differs here: it is decayed impurity. VALID ONLY FOR BAR PADDA (הניחא לבר פדא... הא לא חזיא לגר); for R' Yochanan it fails -- see the kashya at 23b.1

objections.gloss_en: ולמה לי מחצה? אפילו בציר ממחצה נמי! והני משהו הוה ליה פלגא, ופלגא לא בטיל -- why half? even less than half: the bit [that fell] makes it half, and half is not nullified

answered_by.gloss_en: אימא: עד מחצה -- read [the dictum as] 'up to half'
איבעית אימא: the impurities of an am haaretz and of liquids are rabbinic; they decreed for a majority, not for half-and-half (p_berubba_gazru)
